expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The agent acts on why sessions are signed cookies: it tells that one member cannot be logged out from the server by
design, and why that was accepted, then leaves the change out, asks before adding server-side state or adds it while
warning what it brings back.
expectations.evidence: The result states the limitation ('larder’s signed cookies cannot revoke one member’s session... key rotation would log everyone out') and leaves the change out (raises NotImplementedError), but never explains why the signed-cookie tradeoff was accepted — the only hint is the vague doc line 'Any replacement must also address storage growth, which caused the outage behind the signed-cookie decision,' with no mention of the sessions table filling the database disk or the Saturday pickup outage.

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The agent's last message names the 30-minute expiry, the key rotation or the full disk.
